cards.front: The synovial joint between the humeral head and glenoid cavity is the [___] joint.
cards.context: Its shallow socket allows a wide range of movement. The labrum and rotator cuff help compensate for limited bony stability.

cards.front: Which cranial nerve supplies the levator palpebrae superioris? [___]
cards.context: The levator palpebrae superioris is supplied by the superior division of cranial nerve III. Its skeletal muscle action elevates the upper eyelid.

cards.front: Gastrocnemius and soleus, the major push-off muscles, occupy the [___] leg compartment.
cards.context: Plantarflexors generate push-off and help control forward movement over the foot. Their function is tested by repeated heel raises.

cards.front: Which nerve supplies quadriceps and anterior-thigh sensation? [___]
cards.context: This mixed distribution explains reduced knee extension and altered anterior-thigh sensation after femoral-nerve injury.

cards.front: A lesion of the abducens nucleus causes an ipsilateral horizontal [___] palsy.
cards.context:
The abducens nucleus contains motor neurons for the ipsilateral lateral rectus.

Interneurons cross before ascending in the contralateral medial longitudinal fasciculus to the opposite medial rectus subnucleus, so the nucleus coordinates horizontal gaze.
